text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, McQueen. Running again? You were just 
training a moment ago, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This is... well, I ate a bit too much at 
lunch, so to burn off those calories—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...!? Good grief, you really have no 
delicacy whatsoever...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Don't tell me you're satisfied with 
just an ordinary diet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A "normal"... diet? Is there another kind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It sounds rather shady, doesn't it...? Is 
that truly effective?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Naturally! ...Not that I've actually 
tested it, though!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then that's no good at all!! Jeez, please 
don't get in my way!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, I'm about to prove it right now! 
Let's spread the Golshi-style diet method 
to the world together! Come on, please?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No thank you. I'm going to work hard and 
diet steadily on my own!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds like a plan! Then first, let's run 
while shouting 'Begone, excess fat!'"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Some dreams come true just by saying them 
out loud!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there! I can't let you go 
around spilling that to everyone!

Later on, Gold Ship successfully pulled 
off her diet.

"...However, the 'Golshi-Style Diet 
Method' did not catch on in the 
slightest."
